news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues and EPS in line with analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹21.61 (down from ₹24.88 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹9.89b (up 2.3% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.30b (down 13% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 23% (down from 27% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) were also in line with analyst expectations. Revenue is forecast to grow 18% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 5% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 20% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.
